_source: https://www.cos-had.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/04/Ewe_-_A_Bible_Books_Names_List_to_English.pdf (Ewe - A Bible Books Names List, Ewe to English, Pastor T. John Franklin, Church of Salvation, Healing and Deliverance; downloaded 3 Nov 2026). New Testament forms cross-checked against the Ewe text on Bible.is (Mateo, Marko, Luka, Yohanes).
_note: com.eweghana.bible - the app our ewe.json came from - stores the TWI book-name list in its own TotalBooks table (Genesis | Numeri | Yosua | Atemmufo | Mateo ..., identical to the Twi app's list), so its in-app titles cannot be used. Two entries are printed in an unusual word order in that source and are kept verbatim: 'Nyagblɔla Salomo' (Ecclesiastes) and 'Hawo ƒe Ha Salomo' (Song of Solomon). Stray trailing Roman numerals from the PDF's two-column layout were dropped, and three printed forms were corrected to standard Ewe spacing/spelling: 'Psalmowo' to 'Psalmodawo', 'Yeremiaƒe Konyifahawo' to 'Yeremia ƒe Konyifahawo', 'Ʋɔnudrɔ.lawo' to 'Ʋɔnudrɔlawo'. Owner to confirm against a Bible Society of Ghana Ewe Bible before public hosting.
